title: Cambridge IELTS 21 Test 1 Writing Task 2
prompt: The best way to provide enough homes in large cities is to build tall apartment blocks.
directions: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
scenario: The best way to provide enough homes in large cities is to build tall apartment blocks.
requirements: To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
